title: Nemetschek India and Novatr partner on project-based BIM training
summary: A new training partnership builds project-based learning paths around the Nemetschek BIM stack — Archicad, Allplan, Bluebeam, Solibri, and Vectorworks — aimed at getting AEC practitioners production-ready across authoring, review, and coordination.

title: Siemens and HD Hyundai plan a digital shipyard on Xcelerator
summary: The two companies signed an agreement to connect ship design, engineering, manufacturing, and lifecycle management on the Siemens Xcelerator platform, extending digital-twin practice into large-scale shipbuilding.

title: ModuleWorks brings physics-based toolpaths directly into NX CAM
summary: ModuleWorks machining components are now available as plugins for Siemens NX CAM through the Xcelerator portfolio, bringing physics-aware toolpath generation into the NX manufacturing environment.

title: Voxshell raises £800k seed for ChopMesh simulation meshing
summary: UK startup Voxshell closed an £800k seed round to develop ChopMesh, a meshing platform targeting engineering simulation — the meshing step that often bottlenecks CAE preprocessing.

title: EOS pushes additive manufacturing further into aerospace
summary: In a DEVELOP3D profile, EOS's Philipp Stich argues aerospace engineers are still underusing metal additive manufacturing, and outlines where AM design freedom pays off for flight hardware.

title: Autodesk unveils Maya, 3ds Max, and Arnold updates at SIGGRAPH 2026
summary: At SIGGRAPH 2026 Autodesk detailed new capabilities across Maya, 3ds Max, Arnold, and Flow Production Tracking aimed at streamlining animation and VFX pipelines.

title: Autodesk adds an AU for Small Business learning path
summary: Ahead of Autodesk University 2026, Autodesk introduced a small-business learning path plus an expanded free digital pass, aimed at helping small design and make teams get more from AU sessions.

title: NVIDIA backs 'hybrid AI' to reshape computer graphics
summary: DEVELOP3D reports on NVIDIA's push for hybrid AI, where AI agents orchestrate classical rendering tools to build controllable, physically accurate virtual worlds rather than replacing the graphics pipeline outright.

title: WrapOn brings desktop injection moulding to short-run production
summary: WrapOn's compact injection-moulding hardware targets the gap between prototyping and volume production, letting product teams run small batches of moulded parts without full tooling commitments.

title: HP Z Captis adds Adobe Substance 3D Sampler integration
summary: HP's Z Captis material-capture device now feeds Adobe Substance 3D Sampler, converting scanned physical material properties into PBR materials for visualization and product design work.

title: Ency 3.0 adds automation for CNC machine programming
summary: The Ency 3.0 release expands automation workflows for CAM/CNC programming, aiming to cut manual setup when generating machine code for repetitive part families.

title: Blender 5.2 LTS released with node-based physics and rendering gains
summary: Blender 5.2 LTS ships node-powered physics, remote access to asset libraries, and rendering improvements, and carries two years of long-term-support maintenance updates.

title: Autodesk 2026 AI Jobs Report: AI hiring in Design and Make more than doubles
summary: Autodesk's 2026 AI Jobs Report finds AI-related hiring across Design and Make industries more than doubling, while flagging a widening confidence and skills gap for students entering the field.

title: Gstarsoft releases GstarCAD 2026 Beta with enhanced multi-core CPU optimization
summary: Gstarsoft announces the beta release of GstarCAD 2026, delivering significant speed improvements in drawing layouts, 3D orbiting, and dynamic block manipulations. Designers can experience faster processing of heavy DWG files.

title: Revit 2026.1 update adds toposolid performance improvements and MEP routing enhancements
summary: The 2026.1 point release addresses performance bottlenecks in large toposolid operations, adds duct/pipe auto-routing improvements for complex MEP layouts, and fixes several Dynamo Player stability issues reported since launch.

title: SOLIDWORKS 2026 SP3 resolves large assembly performance regressions
summary: Service Pack 3 addresses the assembly open time regression introduced in SP2 for models with 5000+ components, improves PDM vault check-in speed, and adds new DimXpert workflow for automated GD&T on machined faces.

title: IFC 4.3 officially ratified as ISO 16739-1:2026 global standard
summary: buildingSMART International celebrates the formal ISO publication of IFC 4.3, establishing it as the international open standard for BIM infrastructure exchange across railways, roads, bridges, and marine networks.

title: Autodesk Fusion June 2026 update introduces AI-assisted manufacturing setup
summary: The June update for Autodesk Fusion brings AI-powered CAM setup recommendations, improved sheet metal simulation, generative design constraints for 3-axis CNC milling, and enhanced electronics schematic capture.

title: Siemens NX 2406 release expands cloud-native modeling and AI-driven design exploration
summary: NX 2406 introduces expanded cloud collaboration via Teamcenter X, AI-assisted feature recognition for legacy part migration, and convergent modeling improvements for combining mesh and B-Rep in single-body operations.

title: Rhino 9 WIP build introduces SubD-to-NURBS fidelity improvements and ShrinkWrap updates
summary: The latest Rhino 9 Work-in-Progress build addresses SubD-to-NURBS conversion accuracy for manufacturing workflows, improves ShrinkWrap performance on 100M+ point clouds, and adds Grasshopper 2 data tree visualization tools.

title: Bentley OpenRoads Designer 2026 adds corridor drainage integration and clash rules
summary: The latest OpenRoads Designer release introduces automated stormwater pipe network generation from corridor templates, clash detection between utilities and road structures, and enhanced LandXML 2.0 export for machine control.

title: Tekla Structures 2026 focuses on precast concrete and rebar detailing productivity
summary: Tekla Structures 2026 ships with improved precast element handling (hollow-core slabs, double walls), automated rebar group spacing optimization, and IFC4 precast-specific MVD export for fabrication coordination.

title: Chaos releases V-Ray 7 with unified GPU+CPU rendering and Enmesh procedural detailing
summary: V-Ray 7 introduces a unified rendering core that seamlessly switches between GPU and CPU without scene changes, Enmesh for procedural surface detail without geometry, and ACES color management built into the material editor.

title: Graphisoft previews ArchiCAD 28 with redesigned library manager and real-time BIM analytics
summary: ArchiCAD 28 preview demonstrates a redesigned object library with parametric preview rendering, real-time model health analytics dashboard, and improved Teamwork performance for 50+ user projects.

title: PTC Creo 11.1 update adds model-based definition enhancements and Windchill+ integration
summary: Creo 11.1 expands MBD capabilities with automated GD&T inheritance across configurations, improved Windchill+ cloud PLM connectivity, and new composite ply design tools for aerospace applications.

title: Onshape Enterprise adds simultaneous editing analytics and branch diff visualization
summary: The latest Onshape Enterprise update includes real-time collaboration analytics (who edited what, when), visual branch-to-branch geometry diff, and improved FeatureScript performance for custom features with 500+ instances.

title: Civil 3D 2026.1 overhauls corridor modeling performance for 50km+ road projects
summary: The 2026.1 update introduces multi-threaded corridor computation reducing rebuild times by 60% on long alignments, improved data shortcuts for multi-user corridor editing, and native IFC 4.3 alignment export.

title: FreeCAD 1.0 official release marks maturity milestone for open-source parametric CAD
summary: After 20+ years of development, FreeCAD reaches version 1.0 with a stable integrated Assembly workbench, improved topological naming robustness, and Ondsel commercial support options for enterprise users.

title: BricsCAD V25 update adds AI-powered BIM classification and Lisp IDE improvements
summary: BricsCAD V25.2 enhances the AI-based BIM element classification (now supporting MEP components), adds a modern Lisp IDE with IntelliSense-style completion, and improves DWG compatibility with AutoCAD 2026 format.

title: NVIDIA Omniverse adds AEC-specific connectors for Revit, ArchiCAD, and Rhino workflows
summary: New Omniverse connectors enable real-time USD-based collaboration between Revit, ArchiCAD, and Rhino users. Changes in any application propagate live to shared visualization scenes, enabling concurrent design review across disciplines.

title: ISO 19650-6 published: BIM for operational phase and asset management
summary: The sixth part of the ISO 19650 BIM framework addresses information requirements for the operational phase of assets, defining how as-built models and COBie data should be maintained throughout building lifecycle management.

title: CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE R2026x adds generative engineering and multi-physics optimization
summary: The R2026x release integrates generative design with multi-physics simulation constraints (thermal + structural + manufacturing) directly in CATIA, enabling optimized lightweight designs validated for producibility in a single environment.

title: Navisworks 2026 introduces AI-assisted clash grouping and automated resolution suggestions
summary: New AI features in Navisworks 2026 automatically group related clashes by system, suggest resolution strategies based on historical project data, and generate BCF reports with pre-populated resolution recommendations.

title: Ansys 2026 R1 expands GPU solver capabilities and digital twin integration
summary: Ansys 2026 R1 extends GPU-accelerated solving to transient structural and explicit dynamics workloads, adds reduced-order model export for real-time digital twin applications, and improves Fluent meshing for complex rotating machinery.

title: Trimble Connect launches OpenAPI for programmatic model access and custom integrations
summary: Trimble Connect's new REST API enables developers to programmatically upload models, run clash checks, extract quantity data, and manage BCF issues, opening custom BIM workflow automation for enterprise deployments.

title: ZWCAD 2026 official release brings performance gains and enhanced .NET API
summary: ZWCAD 2026 claims 40% faster DWG file opening for drawings over 100MB, expanded .NET API coverage reaching 95% compatibility with AutoCAD .NET, and a new Smart Voice command input system for hands-free drafting.

title: buildingSMART publishes updated IFC4 certification test suite for software vendors
summary: The updated certification suite tests IFC4 Reference View and Design Transfer View compliance with stricter geometric accuracy requirements, helping users verify which BIM tools produce standards-compliant exports.

title: Autodesk Construction Cloud adds predictive scheduling and automated RFI routing
summary: ACC's latest update uses machine learning on historical project data to predict schedule delays, automatically routes RFIs to the correct discipline lead based on content analysis, and adds real-time field-to-office model sync.

title: Rhino 8 Service Release 15 fixes Grasshopper data tree performance and SubD edge cases
summary: SR15 resolves Grasshopper performance degradation with large data trees (10k+ branches), fixes SubD crease edge display artifacts on AMD GPUs, and adds RhinoCode Python 3 improvements for automated workflows.

title: Industry analysis: How generative AI is reshaping CAD software feature roadmaps
summary: Engineering.com surveys 15 major CAD vendors on their AI integration strategies. Key findings: natural language command input, automated feature recognition, and AI-driven design-for-manufacturing checks are the top three investment areas.

title: Digital twin maturity in AEC: From buzzword to operational reality
summary: AEC Magazine interviews facility managers at three major hospitals who have implemented operational digital twins. Key insight: 80% of value comes from simple sensor-to-BIM linking, not advanced AI predictions.

title: GstarCAD Architecture 2026 adds parametric wall section library and room area automation
summary: The architecture vertical for GstarCAD 2026 introduces 200+ parametric wall section definitions compliant with Chinese and international standards, automated room area calculation and labeling, and improved stair/railing generators.

title: Solibri v10 launches with customizable rule templates and automated compliance reporting
summary: Solibri v10 introduces a visual rule builder for non-programmers, pre-built compliance templates for IBC, Eurocode, and accessibility standards, and automated PDF report generation with annotated model screenshots.

title: Twinmotion 2026.1 adds Lumen GI for interiors and direct Revit live-link improvements
summary: Twinmotion 2026.1 enables Lumen global illumination for interior scenes (previously exterior-only), reduces Revit live-link sync time by 40% for large models, and adds 500+ new asset library items for landscape visualization.

title: Blender 4.3 ships with real-time compositor and geometry nodes simulation improvements
summary: Blender 4.3 brings the real-time compositor to production readiness, adds simulation nodes for cloth and soft body in geometry nodes, and improves Cycles X denoising quality for architectural visualization scenes.

title: UK government extends BIM Level 2 mandate to all public housing projects
summary: Starting October 2026, all publicly funded housing projects in the UK must deliver BIM Level 2 (ISO 19650-compliant) models with COBie data for facilities handover, extending the existing mandate beyond major infrastructure.

title: Inventor 2026.1 adds frame generator updates and improved iLogic debugging
summary: Inventor 2026.1 update expands frame generator with DIN and JIS profile libraries, adds breakpoint debugging for iLogic rules, and improves Nastran In-CAD meshing for thin-wall structures common in sheet metal enclosures.

title: COMSOL Multiphysics 6.3 adds battery modeling module and cluster computing improvements
summary: COMSOL 6.3 introduces a dedicated Battery Design Module for lithium-ion cell modeling (electrochemistry + thermal + mechanical coupling), improves cluster computing scalability to 1000+ cores, and adds machine learning surrogate model export.

title: Vectorworks 2026 SP2 improves IFC export and site model grade calculations
summary: Service Pack 2 addresses IFC4 export inconsistencies with space boundaries, improves site model grade calculation accuracy on steep terrain, and adds Data Manager presets for common BIM requirement schemas.

title: OpenFOAM v2406 release adds improved turbulence models and parallel mesh generation
summary: OpenFOAM v2406 introduces the k-omega SST-SAS hybrid turbulence model, parallel snappyHexMesh for distributed mesh generation on HPC clusters, and automated y+ mesh refinement for conjugate heat transfer simulations.

title: SketchUp 2026 introduces tag-based LOD control and improved Layout dimensioning
summary: SketchUp 2026 adds tag-based level-of-detail switching for large models, improves Layout auto-dimensioning with ISO/ANSI standard detection, and introduces native point cloud visualization for scan-to-design workflows.

title: Materialise and ASTM publish joint guidelines for 3MF quality validation in serial production
summary: New joint guidelines define 3MF file validation checks (mesh integrity, material assignment, build orientation) required for quality-certified additive manufacturing in aerospace and medical device production.

title: Enscape 4.2 adds asset scatter painting and improved material library browser
summary: Enscape 4.2 introduces a scatter brush for painting vegetation and objects directly in the Revit/SketchUp viewport, adds 200+ new PBR materials to the built-in library, and improves VR walkthrough comfort with teleport navigation.

title: GstarCAD Mechanical 2026 adds intelligent BOM extraction and parametric standard parts library
summary: GstarCAD Mechanical 2026 introduces automated BOM generation from block attributes, a parametric library of 50,000+ standard mechanical parts (ISO, GB, DIN), and shaft/gear calculation wizards integrated into the drawing workflow.

title: First railway projects successfully exchange data using IFC 4.3 Rail schema
summary: Three European rail infrastructure projects report successful data exchange using the IFC 4.3 rail alignment schema between Bentley, Trimble, and Allplan platforms, validating the standard for real-world interoperability.

title: NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada benchmarks show 2.5x viewport performance gains for heavy CAD assemblies
summary: Independent benchmarks confirm the RTX 6000 Ada delivers 2.5x viewport frame rates in CATIA, NX, and SOLIDWORKS large assemblies (10k+ parts) compared to previous-gen RTX A6000, with 48GB VRAM eliminating LOD degradation.

title: ISO 23386 data dictionary framework gains adoption for BIM property standardization
summary: Major BIM platforms announce support for ISO 23386 data dictionaries, enabling standardized property definitions across software. This reduces manual property mapping between tools and supports automated compliance checking.

title: Autodesk Platform Services (APS) adds Model Derivative API v3 with IFC support
summary: APS Model Derivative v3 enables server-side IFC-to-SVF2 translation, property extraction from IFC models without local software, and programmatic clash detection via REST API for custom BIM coordination platforms.

title: Topcon integrates BIM model consumption directly into machine control receivers
summary: New Topcon MC-Max receivers can directly consume IFC alignment and surface data from BIM models without intermediate conversion to proprietary formats, streamlining the design-to-construction-to-as-built data flow.

title: Allplan 2026 introduces visual scripting for BIM automation and reinforcement optimization
summary: Allplan 2026 adds a visual node-based scripting editor (inspired by Dynamo/Grasshopper) for BIM workflow automation, AI-assisted reinforcement layout optimization, and improved Solibri direct integration for model checking.

title: World's largest 3D-printed concrete building completed: 3-story office in Dubai
summary: A 3-story office building (930 sq meters) has been completed in Dubai using robotic concrete 3D printing, demonstrating viability of additive construction at commercial scale. BIM-to-print workflow used IFC with custom property sets for layer heights.

title: Hexagon acquires CAM software vendor to strengthen smart factory portfolio
summary: Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence expands its CAD/CAM portfolio with a strategic acquisition, aiming to deliver end-to-end digital thread from design through machining with automated quality inspection feedback loops.

title: EU member states progress toward harmonized BIM requirements for public procurement
summary: 14 EU member states now have active BIM mandates for public works. The EU BIM Task Group publishes harmonization guidelines to align national requirements with ISO 19650, reducing cross-border project friction.

title: Spatial releases ACIS 2026 kernel with improved Boolean robustness and healing algorithms
summary: ACIS 2026 kernel update addresses long-standing Boolean operation failures on tangent faces, improves surface healing for imported STEP/IGES with gaps >0.1mm, and adds native support for periodic surfaces in blending operations.

title: GstarCAD Point Cloud module enables direct laser scan viewing in DWG workflow
summary: GstarCAD's new Point Cloud module supports RCS/RCP/E57/LAS format import with 500M+ point display, section clipping, snap-to-point functionality, and automated floor plan extraction from scan data.
